sources: Charak, Elements of Vedic Astrology — ch. VI, VII, XII, XVIII, XIX.
Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer.
Levacy, Beneath a Vedic Sky — skills II and III.
Sutton, The Essentials of Vedic Astrology — grahas and the karmic axis.

natural_benefic_rules.note: The runtime yoga evaluator reads these thresholds rather than hard-coding them, so the two conditional grahas can be argued with in data.
natural_benefic_rules.moon_note: Paksha bala. The careful classical reading is Shukla Ashtami to Krishna Ashtami — the Moon is a benefic while it carries enough light, not merely because it is technically waxing. A one-day-old Moon is a malefic.
natural_benefic_rules.mercury_note: Mercury takes the nature of its company: benefic alone, malefic when it shares a sign with a natural malefic (a waning Moon counts). The Sun is deliberately excluded — Sun with Mercury is the auspicious Budhaditya, not a corruption.

combustion_note: Combustion (asta) is measured from the Sun in longitude. A combust planet loses its ability to give independent results but keeps its ownership duties. Mercury and Venus are least harmed; the Moon and Mars most.
planetary_war: Two non-luminary planets within 1° are in graha yuddha. The one further north in latitude (or the brighter) wins; the loser withholds its results for that period.
functional_nature_rules: Lords of the trikonas (1, 5, 9) are functional benefics for that lagna.
Lords of 3, 6 and 11 are functional malefics.
Lords of 2 and 12 are neutral, taking their colour from their other lordship.
Kendradhipati dosha: a natural benefic owning a kendra (4, 7, 10) loses beneficence; a natural malefic owning one gains it.
Yogakaraka, strictly: one graha owning both a kendra (4/7/10) and a trikona (5/9). Only Mars for Cancer and Leo, Venus for Capricorn and Aquarius, and Saturn for Taurus and Libra qualify.

A lagna lord that also owns a kendra (Mercury for Gemini and Virgo, Jupiter for Sagittarius and Pisces) is strongly benefic but is not called a yogakaraka; it is listed separately as lagna_lord_also_kendra_lord.
Marakas are the lords of the 2nd and 7th; they are read as stress and transition markers, never as mortality indicators.
Badhaka: the 11th house for movable lagnas, the 9th for fixed, the 7th for dual. Its lord obstructs.

Sun.beej_mantra: Om Hraam Hreem Hraum Sah Suryaya Namah
Sun.karaka: soul (atmakaraka), father, vitality, authority, government, title, the eye
Sun.body: heart, eyes (right in men, left in women), bone, stomach, head
Sun.sign_in: A pure fire principle. Strong in fire and in kendras; burns in watery, debilitating ground.
Sun.name: Sun

in_sign.Aries: Direct, self-starting, competitive; leads from the front and will not be second. Exalted — authority comes early.
in_sign.Taurus: Steady authority, fixed values, a stubborn dignity; money and voice matter to the ego.
in_sign.Gemini: Authority through words, versatility, teaching; scattered if the mind is not given one subject.
in_sign.Cancer: Identity is emotional and family-rooted; needs to be needed. Authority softens, sometimes to a fault.
in_sign.Leo: Own sign. Full-strength ego — royal, generous, dramatic; wounded quickly by disrespect.
in_sign.Virgo: Analytical, service-minded, self-critical; authority earned by competence, not by rank.
in_sign.Libra: Debilitated. Authority given away to keep the peace; the self is defined through others. Look for neecha bhanga before calling this weak.
in_sign.Scorpio: Intense, secretive, transformative; power held in reserve and used once, hard.
in_sign.Sagittarius: Philosophical, teacherly, ethical; needs a cause to be loyal to before a career.
in_sign.Capricorn: Ambitious, patient, structural; status built slowly and kept. Political skill.
in_sign.Aquarius: Unorthodox authority; leadership of a group or cause rather than of a hierarchy.
in_sign.Pisces: Compassionate, imaginative, self-effacing; authority through art, faith or service.

in_house.1: Strong personality, prominent forehead, authority in one's own name; a temper about dignity. Health runs on the heart and eyes.
in_house.2: Wealth through authority or father; commanding speech; family pride. Can scorch the family budget.
in_house.3: Courage, initiative, strong younger-sibling karma; good for self-effort, hard on brothers.
in_house.4: Restless at home; may move away from the birth place; mother's or father's authority contested. Digbala-poor.
in_house.5: Authority through intellect and children; few but notable children; speculation should be avoided.
in_house.6: Excellent placement — defeats enemies, debt and disease through will; good for service, medicine, litigation.
in_house.7: Authority handed to the partner; late or official marriage; the spouse is proud. Some separation in long absences.
in_house.8: Long-lived but stressed; interest in the occult; father's health or legacy is a theme. Not a soft placement.
in_house.9: Fortunate; father, dharma, law, long travel and teaching all favoured. One of the best places for the Sun.
in_house.10: Directional strength (digbala). Career, government, public name. The strongest Sun for status.
in_house.11: Steady gains through authority and elders; ambitious friendships; income rises with rank.
in_house.12: Expenditure, foreign residence, hospitals or retreat; visibility is withheld until it is earned quietly. Eye care matters.

Moon.nature: benefic when waxing, malefic when waning or afflicted
Moon.beej_mantra: Om Shraam Shreem Shraum Sah Chandraya Namah
Moon.karaka: mind (manah), mother, public, home, fluids, moods, the breast
Moon.body: blood, lymph, breasts, stomach lining, left eye in men
Moon.motion_note: never retrograde; strength depends on paksha (waxing/waning)
Moon.sign_in: The Moon takes the colour of the sign more literally than any other graha; read the sign as the mood a person lives in.
Moon.name: Moon

in_sign.Aries: Quick, impulsive, independent mind; feelings arrive and pass fast.
in_sign.Taurus: Exalted. Steady, sensory, loyal mind; needs comfort and beauty to feel safe.
in_sign.Gemini: Curious, talkative, restless mind; two of everything, including opinions.
in_sign.Cancer: Own sign. Deeply feeling, maternal, tidal; home and mother are the whole weather system.
in_sign.Leo: Proud, warm, performing mind; needs an audience and repays it with loyalty.
in_sign.Virgo: Precise, worrying, service-oriented mind; calms itself by fixing things.
in_sign.Libra: Relational mind; cannot settle until the room is balanced. Charm as a coping strategy.
in_sign.Scorpio: Debilitated. Intense, secretive, all-or-nothing feeling; early emotional wound that becomes depth. Check for neecha bhanga.
in_sign.Sagittarius: Optimistic, wandering, meaning-seeking mind; restless for the bigger picture.
in_sign.Capricorn: Reserved, dutiful, ambitious mind; feelings postponed until the work is done.
in_sign.Aquarius: Detached, humanitarian, unconventional mind; loves people in general more easily than in particular.
in_sign.Pisces: Porous, compassionate, dreaming mind; absorbs the room. Boundaries are the lifelong lesson.

in_house.1: Sensitive, changeable, publicly readable; popularity comes easily. Waxing Moon here is excellent.
in_house.2: Wealth through the public; sweet speech; family and food are emotional anchors.
in_house.3: Courage that fluctuates; close to siblings, especially sisters; short journeys frequent.
in_house.4: Digbala. Own house of the Moon — strong home life, attachment to mother, land and vehicles. Best house for the Moon.
in_house.5: Emotional creativity; strong bond with children; a speculative streak. Good for teaching and arts.
in_house.6: Emotional strain through work and health; oversensitivity to conflict. Waning Moon here is hard.
in_house.7: Marriage is the emotional centre; partner is caring but moody; public-facing partnerships.
in_house.8: Emotional turbulence, occult sensitivity, chronic worry; secret sorrows. Needs real sleep hygiene.
in_house.9: Faith, travel, teachers and father all emotionally charged; happy long journeys.
in_house.10: Public career; the work is with people. Mother influences the career. Digbala-poor but socially strong.
in_house.11: Large network, gains through many people, popular; income through the public.
in_house.12: Foreign lands, retreat, hospitals, sleep and imagination; a private inner life. Isolation must be chosen, not fallen into.

Mars.beej_mantra: Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namah
Mars.karaka: courage, siblings (younger), land and property, conflict, surgery, engineering
Mars.body: muscle, bone marrow, blood, genitals, forehead
Mars.motion_note: retrograde roughly every 2 years; intensifies rather than weakens
Mars.sign_in: Mars shows where the chart fights. In its own or exalted sign it is competence; debilitated it is a temper with no craft attached.
Mars.name: Mars

in_sign.Aries: Own sign and moolatrikona. Clean courage, direct action, physical competence.
in_sign.Taurus: Slow to anger and immovable once angry; fights for possessions and comfort.
in_sign.Gemini: Argumentative energy; fights with words, wit and paperwork.
in_sign.Cancer: Debilitated. Anger turns inward or sideways — moods, sulks, indirect force. Neecha bhanga matters here.
in_sign.Leo: Proud, commanding, showy courage; leads a fight rather than joining one.
in_sign.Virgo: Critical, methodical, technical energy; surgical when disciplined, nagging when not.
in_sign.Libra: Energy spent negotiating; fights for fairness, avoids the fight itself.
in_sign.Scorpio: Own sign. Deep, strategic, relentless energy; holds a grudge and a plan.
in_sign.Sagittarius: Crusading energy; fights for a belief and travels for it.
in_sign.Capricorn: Exalted. Disciplined ambition, executive force, endurance — the best Mars for building.
in_sign.Aquarius: Energy for the group, the cause, the invention; impersonal and stubborn.
in_sign.Pisces: Diffuse, compassionate, inspired energy; strong in service and art, weak in confrontation.

in_house.1: Kuja dosha house. Physical, competitive, scarred; a fighter's constitution and a short fuse.
in_house.2: Kuja dosha house. Harsh speech, family friction, money made and spent by force.
in_house.3: Excellent — courage, initiative, competence; strong younger siblings; self-made drive.
in_house.4: Kuja dosha house. Friction at home, land disputes, restless domestic life; property acquired by effort.
in_house.5: Sharp intellect and strong will; risk appetite; strain around children or speculation.
in_house.6: Excellent — defeats enemies, debt and disease; good for surgery, litigation, competitive work.
in_house.7: Kuja dosha house. Passion and friction in marriage; partner is forceful. Needs a partner who matches the heat, not one who absorbs it.
in_house.8: Kuja dosha house. Accident and surgery flag; strong occult or investigative capacity; in-law friction.
in_house.9: Fighting for a belief; disputes with father or teachers; energetic long travel.
in_house.10: Excellent — career drive, executive force, engineering and command. Digbala.
in_house.11: Gains through effort and competition; forceful friends; ambition rewarded.
in_house.12: Energy spent in secret, abroad, or in hospitals; hidden enemies; poorly directed anger. Physical outlet required.

Mercury.nature: benefic alone, takes on the nature of whatever it joins
Mercury.beej_mantra: Om Braam Breem Braum Sah Budhaya Namah
Mercury.karaka: speech, intellect, commerce, documents, skill, nerves, maternal uncle
Mercury.body: skin, nervous system, lungs, hands, tongue
Mercury.sign_in: Mercury is the only graha that is exalted in its own sign. Read its sign for how the person thinks, and its company for whether the thinking is honest.
Mercury.name: Mercury

in_sign.Aries: Fast, blunt, decisive speech; thinks by arguing.
in_sign.Taurus: Slow, practical, retentive mind; speaks about money, food, comfort and craft.
in_sign.Gemini: Own sign. Versatile, quick, journalistic mind; the classic communicator.
in_sign.Cancer: Emotive, retentive, indirect speech; remembers everything, says a third of it.
in_sign.Leo: Confident, declarative, creative mind; speaks to be heard.
in_sign.Virgo: Exalted and own sign. Analytical, editorial, exacting mind — the strongest Mercury.
in_sign.Libra: Diplomatic, balanced, comparative mind; sees both sides, decides late.
in_sign.Scorpio: Investigative, secretive, penetrating mind; researcher's Mercury.
in_sign.Sagittarius: Broad, philosophical, sometimes careless mind; good at meaning, poor at detail.
in_sign.Capricorn: Serious, structural, economical mind; says only what is useful.
in_sign.Aquarius: Original, systemic, inventive mind; thinks in models.
in_sign.Pisces: Debilitated. Intuitive and imaginative but imprecise; contracts and detail need a second reader. Check neecha bhanga.

in_house.1: Digbala. Intelligent, articulate, youthful; identity built on communication.
in_house.2: Wealth through speech, trade, writing; excellent for commerce and accounting.
in_house.3: Skill in writing and short travel; clever siblings; craft and media.
in_house.4: Intellect applied to home and land; study at home; mother is talkative or educated.
in_house.5: Sharp mind, good for teaching and analysis; clever children; strong in counsel.
in_house.6: Analytical service; good for medicine, audit, law; nervous complaints under stress.
in_house.7: Business partnerships; a younger or intellectual spouse; contracts matter enormously.
in_house.8: Research and the occult; interest in what is hidden; careful with documents and inheritance.
in_house.9: Higher learning, publishing, law, philosophy; a scholar's placement.
in_house.10: Career in trade, media, writing, analysis; a professional communicator.
in_house.11: Gains through networks, trade and younger people; profitable friendships.
in_house.12: Mind runs privately; research, foreign work, writing done alone. Watch for anxious over-thinking.

Jupiter.beej_mantra: Om Graam Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namah
Jupiter.karaka: wisdom, teacher, children, wealth, dharma, husband in a woman's chart, expansion
Jupiter.body: liver, fat, thighs, arterial system, ears
Jupiter.sign_in: Jupiter expands whatever the sign already is. In a friendly sign it is grace; in Capricorn it is a teacher forced to run a budget.
Jupiter.name: Jupiter

in_sign.Aries: Enthusiastic teacher, pioneer of ideas; belief precedes evidence.
in_sign.Taurus: Wealth-minded wisdom; grows resources, values and voice.
in_sign.Gemini: Learned and curious, but scattered belief; many teachers, no guru.
in_sign.Cancer: Exalted. The best Jupiter — grace, protection, generosity, real wisdom. Blesses home, mother, children.
in_sign.Leo: Dignified, authoritative teaching; wisdom worn visibly.
in_sign.Virgo: Wisdom applied to detail and service; the critical scholar. Jupiter is uneasy in Mercury's exacting ground.
in_sign.Libra: Wisdom through relationship and law; the good counsel of a fair mind.
in_sign.Scorpio: Occult, researching, transformative wisdom; interest in what is hidden.
in_sign.Sagittarius: Own sign and moolatrikona. Natural teacher, philosopher, priest; ethics as spine.
in_sign.Capricorn: Debilitated. Wisdom under a budget; faith replaced by pragmatism, generosity by calculation. Neecha bhanga matters greatly here.
in_sign.Aquarius: Wisdom for the collective; reformer, humanitarian, systems thinker.
in_sign.Pisces: Own sign. Devotional, compassionate, mystical wisdom; gives without ledger.

in_house.1: Digbala. Optimism, protection, a visible good nature; grace on the body and the reputation.
in_house.2: Wealth, learned speech, good family; classical placement for money.
in_house.3: Courage with ethics; benefit through siblings; but Jupiter in an upachaya is mildly weakened.
in_house.4: Excellent — happy home, educated mother, land and vehicles, inner contentment.
in_house.5: Best for children, teaching and intellect; a guru's placement. Strong purva punya.
in_house.6: Jupiter's least comfortable house; work and debt expand. Good for healing professions, hard on the waistline and the budget.
in_house.7: Excellent for marriage — a wise, protective spouse; grace in partnership.
in_house.8: Longevity and occult depth; inheritance and insurance; a protected 8th.
in_house.9: Best house for Jupiter — dharma, father, fortune, teachers, long travel, publishing.
in_house.10: Career with ethics and visibility; teaching, law, finance, counsel.
in_house.11: Large and easy gains; influential friends; one of the best money placements.
in_house.12: Charitable, retreat-loving, spiritually inclined; expenditure on good causes; protection abroad.

Venus.beej_mantra: Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namah
Venus.karaka: marriage, wife in a man's chart, art, vehicles, comfort, luxury, desire
Venus.body: reproductive system, kidneys, throat, face, eyes
Venus.sign_in: Venus shows the standard of comfort a person will not go below, and the taste they apply to it.
Venus.name: Venus

in_sign.Aries: Impulsive, direct desire; falls fast, tires fast.
in_sign.Taurus: Own sign. Sensual, loyal, comfort-loving; steady affection and good taste.
in_sign.Gemini: Flirtatious, communicative love; needs conversation more than devotion.
in_sign.Cancer: Nurturing, domestic love; partner is family or nothing.
in_sign.Leo: Romantic, generous, dramatic love; needs to be adored.
in_sign.Virgo: Debilitated. Love filtered through criticism and service; affection shown as usefulness. Check neecha bhanga — Venus in Virgo works when the person stops auditing the partner.
in_sign.Libra: Own sign and moolatrikona. The strongest social Venus — partnership, art, fairness, grace.
in_sign.Scorpio: Intense, possessive, transformative love; all or nothing.
in_sign.Sagittarius: Free, philosophical, adventurous love; needs room and a shared belief.
in_sign.Capricorn: Cautious, status-aware, durable love; slow to commit, hard to shake.
in_sign.Aquarius: Unconventional, friendship-first love; loyalty without ownership.
in_sign.Pisces: Exalted. Devotional, boundless, self-giving love — the strongest Venus. Also the easiest to exploit.

in_house.1: Beauty, charm, a pleasant presence; comfort-seeking; attractive to others.
in_house.2: Wealth through art, beauty and speech; a sweet voice; enjoyment of food and family.
in_house.3: Artistic skill, pleasant siblings, enjoyable short travel; some laziness in effort.
in_house.4: Digbala. Beautiful home, vehicles, land, a comfortable mother; domestic happiness.
in_house.5: Romance, creativity, children, pleasure in learning; the lover's 5th.
in_house.6: Venus in service; enjoyment complicated by work and health; relationships with colleagues.
in_house.7: Own natural house — marriage and partnership are central and usually favourable. Watch for over-dependence on the partner.
in_house.8: Passionate and secretive; gains through partner or inheritance; longevity supported.
in_house.9: Grace, fortune, travel for pleasure, a cultured belief system; a fortunate Venus.
in_house.10: Career in art, beauty, luxury, diplomacy; public charm.
in_house.11: Gains through women, art and partnerships; luxurious friendships; strong income.
in_house.12: Own natural house of Venus in the sense of bedroom and retreat — pleasure in private, foreign comfort, spiritual love. Also the house where indulgence hides.

Saturn.nature: the great malefic (cold, dry, slow, constricting)
Saturn.beej_mantra: Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaischaraya Namah
Saturn.karaka: longevity, duty, delay, labour, servants, sorrow, discipline, the old
Saturn.body: nerves, teeth, knees, joints, skin, spleen
Saturn.sign_in: Saturn delays what the sign wants and then makes it permanent. Never read Saturn as denial without first checking the delay.
Saturn.name: Saturn

in_sign.Aries: Debilitated. Duty resented; discipline arrives as frustration. Structure has to be learned the hard way. Check neecha bhanga.
in_sign.Taurus: Patient accumulation; slow, permanent material gain. Hard on speech and family early.
in_sign.Gemini: Disciplined thinking, methodical communication; slow learner who ends as the expert.
in_sign.Cancer: Emotional restraint, heavy home karma, duty to mother; warmth arrives late and lasts.
in_sign.Leo: Authority resisted then earned; pride disciplined by public failure and rebuilt.
in_sign.Virgo: Excellent working Saturn — detail, service, method, health discipline.
in_sign.Libra: Exalted. Justice, fairness, real authority; duty in partnership. The strongest Saturn.
in_sign.Scorpio: Hard, deep, transformative Saturn; chronic pressure that produces genuine occult or research capacity.
in_sign.Sagittarius: Disciplined belief; a philosopher who tests doctrine against life. Late but durable faith.
in_sign.Capricorn: Own sign and karmic home. Ambition, endurance, structure; slow rise, long reign.
in_sign.Aquarius: Own sign and moolatrikona. Saturn for the collective — reform, systems, long service.
in_sign.Pisces: Duty to the unseen; isolation, service, renunciation. Sleep and boundaries are the health issue.

in_house.1: A serious, slow-maturing, sometimes burdened self; health and confidence arrive late but hold.
in_house.2: Delayed and hard-earned wealth; reserved speech; family duty. Saturn as 2nd-house maraka must be watched.
in_house.3: Excellent upachaya — courage built by grinding; disciplined effort; distance from siblings.
in_house.4: Heavy home karma, duty to mother, delayed property; melancholy at home. Property when it comes is permanent.
in_house.5: Delay or seriousness about children; disciplined intellect; teaching rather than speculation.
in_house.6: Excellent upachaya — defeats enemies and debt by endurance; the professional's 6th; chronic rather than acute health issues.
in_house.7: Digbala. Delayed but durable marriage; an older or serious partner; the marriage is a duty as much as a pleasure.
in_house.8: Longevity karaka in the house of longevity; chronic conditions; deep endurance; occult capacity.
in_house.9: Duty as dharma; delayed fortune; a strict father or teacher; faith tested and then durable.
in_house.10: Excellent — career built by labour, authority through endurance, lasting status. Saturn's own natural house.
in_house.11: Excellent upachaya — best house for Saturn's gains; income rises steadily with age and seniority.
in_house.12: Expenditure, isolation, foreign residence, insomnia, service to the unseen; the moksha placement for Saturn.

Rahu.nature: malefic, shadow; acts like Saturn, amplifies its dispositor
Rahu.beej_mantra: Om Bhraam Bhreem Bhraum Sah Rahave Namah
Rahu.karaka: obsession, foreign lands, technology, scandal, sudden scale, the grandparents' karma
Rahu.body: none directly; acts through its sign lord and house
Rahu.sign_in: Rahu has no body of its own; it borrows the sign lord's. Read Rahu's dispositor before reading Rahu.
Rahu.name: Rahu

in_sign.Aries: Reckless drive to be first; identity built on shock and speed.
in_sign.Taurus: Exalted (traditional). Hunger for wealth, luxury and status; can be extraordinarily productive.
in_sign.Gemini: Hunger for information, media, messaging; brilliant and unreliable in equal parts.
in_sign.Cancer: Emotional hunger; the home is foreign, the mother's story unfinished.
in_sign.Leo: Hunger for fame and authority; imitation of power until power is real.
in_sign.Virgo: Hunger through service, analysis, medicine; obsessive detail. Rahu works well here.
in_sign.Libra: Hunger through relationship; unconventional partnerships, foreign spouse.
in_sign.Scorpio: Debilitated (traditional). Hunger for the hidden; occult obsession, crisis, sudden loss and gain.
in_sign.Sagittarius: Hunger for doctrine; a convert's zeal, sometimes to the wrong teacher.
in_sign.Capricorn: Hunger for status and structure; political and corporate ambition that works.
in_sign.Aquarius: Own-ish sign. Rahu is comfortable here — technology, networks, invention, mass scale.
in_sign.Pisces: Hunger for dissolution; escapism, foreign shores, spirituality or addiction.

in_house.1: Strong, unconventional, magnetic self; identity built abroad or against the grain. Classical caution: ambition outruns the body.
in_house.2: Hunger for wealth; unconventional income; harsh or foreign speech; family not as expected.
in_house.3: Excellent upachaya — Rahu here is productive: courage, media, communication, self-made rise.
in_house.4: Restless home; foreign residence; mother's story complicated; property through unusual means.
in_house.5: Unconventional children or none by plan; speculation risk; strong but erratic intellect.
in_house.6: Excellent upachaya — Rahu defeats enemies, debt and competition; good for medicine, law, litigation.
in_house.7: Foreign or unconventional partner; intense marriage; strong desire with poor judgment early.
in_house.8: Occult, research, sudden events, in-law issues, insurance and tax; a house Rahu makes eventful.
in_house.9: Unorthodox belief; foreign dharma; complicated relationship with father and tradition.
in_house.10: Powerful career Rahu — ambition, scale, public prominence; ethics must be watched.
in_house.11: Best house for Rahu — large gains, big networks, mass reach, fulfilment of desire.
in_house.12: Foreign residence, isolation, research, expenditure; strong moksha pull, or escapism if it is refused.

Ketu.nature: malefic, shadow; acts like Mars, but inwardly and separatively
Ketu.beej_mantra: Om Sraam Sreem Sraum Sah Ketave Namah
Ketu.karaka: moksha, detachment, past-life skill, sudden cutting, flags and banners, the maternal grandfather
Ketu.body: none directly; acts through its sign lord and house
Ketu.sign_in: Ketu subtracts from whatever the sign is about. The competence is already there from before; the appetite for it is not.
Ketu.name: Ketu

in_sign.Aries: Cuts identity; the person resists being pinned down. Impulsive detachment.
in_sign.Taurus: Debilitated (traditional). Cuts comfort, family and savings; the body is not a priority. Money arrives and leaves.
in_sign.Gemini: Cuts speech and short networks; a quiet expert who dislikes explaining.
in_sign.Cancer: Cuts the home; mother, roots or house feel unavailable. Deep inner peace once accepted.
in_sign.Leo: Cuts self-display; hides talent, dislikes the stage even when good on it.
in_sign.Virgo: Cuts the fuss over detail; exceptional at diagnosis and healing, indifferent to praise.
in_sign.Libra: Cuts partnership appetite; marriage happens but the person stays private inside it.
in_sign.Scorpio: Exalted (traditional). Deep occult and research capacity; crisis metabolised into insight.
in_sign.Sagittarius: Cuts dogma; a natural mystic who distrusts organised belief.
in_sign.Capricorn: Cuts ambition; competent at structure without wanting the throne.
in_sign.Aquarius: Cuts the group; works with systems, avoids the meeting.
in_sign.Pisces: Moksha placement. Strong spiritual pull, foreign life, retreat, dissolution of the ordinary.

in_house.1: Detached, self-effacing identity; the body feels borrowed; strong past-life competence with no appetite for display.
in_house.2: Cut from family wealth and speech; money comes and goes; a blunt, sparing tongue.
in_house.3: Courage without ambition; distance from siblings; quiet skill.
in_house.4: Cut from home and mother; property held loosely; deep inner peace once the loss is accepted.
in_house.5: Classical caution for children — delay, few, or a spiritual rather than domestic 5th. Strong intuition and mantra capacity.
in_house.6: Excellent — Ketu cuts enemies, debt and disease; healing capacity; good for medicine and occult diagnosis.
in_house.7: Detachment inside marriage; the partner is present but the bond is inward. Marriage is possible, attachment is the work.
in_house.8: Strong occult and research placement; sudden reversals; longevity questions handled by discipline, not by fear.
in_house.9: Mystic without a church; distance from father or tradition; direct spiritual experience.
in_house.10: Career held lightly; competence without careerism; may leave a good post for meaning.
in_house.11: Gains arrive then dissolve; network is thin but real; detachment from profit.
in_house.12: Best house for Ketu — moksha, foreign lands, retreat, deep meditation, dissolution of the ordinary self.
